per_query.query_text: PDCP SDU discard rate spiking on uplink for one cell sector

(3) Uplink scheduler — is UE getting sufficient resource grants? (4) PDCP discard timer configuration — may be too aggressive. (5) Check for uplink interference source (PIM, external). Correlate with HARQ BLER and PHR statistics in the RRM counters.
